parts.text: 第二次创建命令也在 PowerShell 解析阶段被拒绝，仍未发送请求或写库。我会换成 JSON 字符串拼装，避免对象字面量语法；仍只做一次注册提交，结果不确定时不重试。

tool_input.description: Submit one synthetic registration and verify login
tool_input.command: $solverPath='C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\skills\captcha-recognizer\scripts\solve-captcha.mjs'; $createAttempted=$false; try { $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMddHHmmssfff'; $tail='{0:D5}' -f (Get-Random -Minimum 10000 -Maximum 99999); $companyName='T2334-'+$stamp; $uscc='91'+'320594'+'T2334'+$tail; $legalName='测试联调'; $passportNo='T2334-'+$stamp; $captchaData=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/code' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15; $answerLines=@($captchaData.img | & node $solverPath '-'); $captchaAnswer=($answerLines -join '').Trim(); if($captchaAnswer -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$'){throw 'captcha solve failed before create'}; $payloadText='{"tCyjgInfo":{"companyType":"01","uniformSocialCreditCode":"'+$uscc+'","companyName":"'+$companyName+'","legalRepresentative":"'+$legalName+'","legalPersonCertificateType":"004","corporateIdNo":"'+$passportNo+'","orgId":1,"outFlag":"1"},"tCyjgBgxx":{"contacts":"'+$legalName+'"},"code":"'+$captchaAnswer+'","uuid":"'+$captchaData.uuid+'"}'; $createAttempted=$true; $createResponse=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/company/base/createTempAccount' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $payloadText -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 25; $createResult=$createResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $createCode=[int]$createResult.code; if($createCode -ne 200 -or -not $createResult.data.userName -or -not $createResult.data.password){$category='other'; if([string]$createResult.msg -match '统一社会信用代码已存在|企业名称已存在'){$category='duplicate'} elseif([string]$createResult.msg -match '验证码'){$category='captcha'} elseif([string]$createResult.msg -match '企业所属机构不存在'){$category='org-mapping'}; 'registrationCode={0}; category={1}; no retry performed' -f $createCode,$category} else {$tempAccount=$createResult.data; $loginCaptcha=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/code' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15; $loginAnswerLines=@($loginCaptcha.img | & node $solverPath '-'); $loginAnswer=($loginAnswerLines -join '').Trim(); if($loginAnswer -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$'){'registrationCode=200; loginAttempted=false; recordPersisted=true'} else {$userNameJson=ConvertTo-Json -InputObject ([string]$tempAccount.userName) -Compress; $passwordJson=ConvertTo-Json -InputObject ([string]$tempAccount.password) -Compress; $loginPayload='{"username":'+$userNameJson+',"password":'+$passwordJson+',"code":"'+$loginAnswer+'","uuid":"'+$loginCaptcha.uuid+'"}'; $loginResponse=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/auth/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $loginPayload -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 25; $loginResult=$loginResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $loginCode=[int]$loginResult.code; $token=[string]$loginResult.token; if(-not $token -and $loginResult.data -is [string]){$token=[string]$loginResult.data}; if(-not $token -and $loginResult.data.token){$token=[string]$loginResult.data.token}; $infoCode='not-queried'; $userType='not-queried'; if($loginCode -eq 200 -and $token){$infoResponse=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/system/user/getInfo' -Method Get -Headers @{Authorization=('Bearer '+$token)} -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15; $infoResult=$infoResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $infoCode=[string]$infoResult.code; if($infoResult.user.userType){$userType=[string]$infoResult.user.userType} elseif($infoResult.data.user.userType){$userType=[string]$infoResult.data.user.userType}}; 'registrationCode=200; loginCode={0}; getInfoCode={1}; userType={2}; syntheticMarker=T2334; recordPersisted=true' -f $loginCode,$infoCode,$userType}} } catch { if($createAttempted){'registration attempt outcome may be partial or uncertain; do not retry; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name} else {'stopped before registration write; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name} }
